seniors.label: Пожилые
seniors.paletteHint: text contrast at least 7:1 (WCAG AAA), dark text on a light background, calm muted colors, state shown by shape/icon as well as color, no flashing
avoid: tap targets smaller than 88 logical px (14 mm, Leitão & Silva 2012)
swipe-only controls; if a swipe is needed, make its target at least 117 logical px (17.5 mm) and offer a tap alternative
pinch, spread and other multi-finger gestures
long press as an action (older users press slowly, so taps get read as holds or drags)
requiring successive taps faster than about 1 s apart
fixed time pressure that cannot be relaxed
modes where the same gesture does different things
text smaller than 25 logical px
thin font weights
flashing more than 3 times per second
forcing an ad or a wait before the player can continue
notes: Main buttons: 88+ logical px. Dense boards (match-3, grids) may go down to 72 px cells with at most 5 columns and visible gaps; Kobayashi 2011 measured 5.6% errors at about 11 mm
Prefer drags to the right or down over drags to the left or up (Gao & Sun 2015)
Give sound or vibration feedback on every tap; combined sound and vibration worked best (Hwangbo 2013)
One short instruction on the start screen with a visual hint; older users needed cues to discover gestures (Kobayashi 2011)
Forgiving play: extra lives or no instant fail, gentle difficulty ramp; ease of play is the top-valued feature for 49% of gamers 50+ (AARP 2023)
Card/solitaire and word games map to genre 'other'; they rank among the top genres for 50+ (AARP 2023, Yandex 2022)

sources.title: Leitão & Silva 2012, Target and spacing sizes for smartphone UIs for older adults: n=40, aged 65–95; tap targets >14 mm and swipe targets 17.5 mm reach >97% accuracy; spacing had no significant effect

Kobayashi et al. 2011, Elderly user evaluation of mobile touchscreen interactions: n=20, in their 60s–70s; error rate on a small device 39% / 6.5% / 5.6% at about 4.7 / 7.8 / 10.9 mm; tap about 1.0 s, drag 2.2 s, pinch 2.8 s; recommends targets of 8 mm or more
Gao & Sun 2015, Human Factors 57(5): buttons larger than 15.9×9.0 mm performed better for older adults; rightward and downward drags preferred; older adults preferred click-based designs
Hwangbo et al. 2013, Pointing performance of elderly users on smartphones: target size, spacing and screen location all matter; combined sound and vibration feedback was best
Apple HIG, Typography: iOS Dynamic Type Body at xxxLarge = 23 pt, AX1 = 28 pt; thin weights need larger sizes
Yeh 2020, Heliyon 6(6): n=32, aged 65–76, on a tablet; reading time 9.6 s at 10 pt vs 2.2 s at 22 pt
NN/g 2013, Usability for Senior Citizens: seniors 43% slower and task success 55.3% vs 74.5%; dexterity score 73% vs 95%
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3/1.4.6 Understanding: 4.5:1 is based on 20/40 acuity, typical at about age 80; 7:1 (AAA) is for 20/80
Nap, de Kort & IJsselsteijn 2009, Senior gamers: in-game speed was the prominent difficulty; they ask for adjustable time; 8 of 10 played card games
Der & Deary 2006, Psychol Aging 21(1): n=7,130; choice reaction time slows throughout adulthood, simple reaction time after about 50
Apple HIG, Accessibility: offer difficulty accommodations, e.g. adjustable reaction time; avoid multifinger gestures; offer onscreen alternatives to swipes

AARP 2023, The 50-Plus Gamer: n=2,657 monthly gamers 50+; puzzle/logic 73%, card/tile 69%; 84% play on a smartphone; ease of play is the top feature (49%); 59% are frustrated by ads required to continue
ESA Essential Facts 2025: 73% of players aged 61–90 prefer puzzle games
Яндекс, 2022: в браузерных играх 55+ предпочитают пасьянсы («Паук», «Косынка»), 45–54 — нарды и дурака
MyTracker 2020: игроки 65+ охотнее всего платят в кроссвордах, судоку, викторинах и три-в-ряд
Сбер «Ловлю на слове»: ~350 тыс. участников, среднее время в игре 53 мин (данные банка; методика не раскрыта)
speedMultiplier 0.6, roundSeconds [60,180], the 72 px board-cell floor and uiScale 1.83 (= 88/48) have no direct source; they are derived from the studies above

kids.label: Дети
kids.paletteHint: bright friendly colors, rounded shapes, characters that react when tapped; keep text-to-background contrast at least 4.5:1; no flashing
avoid: tap targets smaller than 80 logical px; for ages 3–5 use 134 px (2 cm, NN/g)
double tap, long press, two-handed or multi-finger gestures
precise drag-to-target placement
fast reactions for the youngest players (NN/g: under 5)
reading-heavy rules; younger children don't read
anything that looks like an ad or a tiny close button
violence (Yandex Games 3.4.3, 8.3.6: content must suit all ages)
flashing more than 3 times per second; photosensitive epilepsy most often starts at ages 7–19
losing too fast
notes: Ignore a repeat tap that lands near the previous target within a short window; in Anthony 2012, 96% of these 'holdover' taps came from children (the 250 ms window is a heuristic)
Offer several ways to do the main action: drag, a tap on an arrow, or a tap on a screen half (NN/g)
Instant feedback on every tap: sound, animation, character reaction (NN/g)
Icons and pictures instead of text; any text uses short words
Keep everything on one screen with no scrolling; younger children avoid scrolling (NN/g)

sources.title: NN/g 2018, Design for Kids Based on Their Physical Development: touch targets at least 2×2 cm for young children (vs 1×1 cm for adults); under 9 use tap/swipe/drag; under 5 avoid fast reactions and two-handed input; adult-level input at about 11

NN/g 2019, Children's UX (n=125, aged 3–12): fonts 14 pt for younger and 12 pt for older children (adults 12 pt); children want immediate feedback; ads are hard to tell from content; younger children avoid scrolling
Anthony et al. 2012, ITS (children 7–16 vs adults): first-try miss rate 23.1% vs 16.9%; 3.2 mm targets too small; ≥6.35 mm needed about one attempt; 96% of holdover taps came from children
Hiniker et al. 2015, Touchscreen Prompts for Preschoolers (n=34, aged 2–5): in-app prompts didn't work for children under 3; cites 73% success at age 3 and 89% over 5 (Vatavu 2015)
Material Design: 48×48 dp ≈ 9 mm, 8 dp spacing; larger targets for children whose motor coordination is still developing
Google Play Families, Ads and Monetization: no ads that look like content; interrupting ads closable after 5 s; no evasive close buttons
Apple Kids Category: age bands 5 and under, 6–8, 9–11; parental gate for purchases and external links
Epilepsy Society 2025: photosensitive epilepsy is most often first seen at ages 7–19
Альфа «Рыбки в банке» — раннер «для детей» (без цифр)

80 px (≈12–12.7 mm) is an interpolation for ages 6–12 between the adult 9 mm (Material) and the preschool 20 mm (NN/g) and matches the largest size in Anthony 2012; speedMultiplier, roundSeconds and the palette are not sourced; no primary source on kids' attention span was found

teens.label: Подростки
teens.paletteHint: modern, confident, not childish; bold accents on a dark or neutral base, but no garish 'loud' color mixes and no heavy decorative animation
avoid: childish visuals and patronizing copy (NN/g teens)
small fonts; teens complained about them (NN/g)
slow start, pop-ups, long tutorials
heavy decorative animation
flashing more than 3 times per second (photosensitive epilepsy onset peaks at ages 7–19)
notes: Score chase: best score on screen and a short result card to show friends; 72% of teen players play to spend time with others (Pew 2024)
Ramp difficulty quickly; reaction speed is near its lifetime peak (in-game latency starts rising around age 24, Thompson 2014)
Text at about 6th-grade reading level, a few words per screen (NN/g)

sources.title: NN/g 2019, Teenagers on the Web (n=100, aged 13–17): dislike childish design, heavy animation, loud colors and patronizing copy; complain about small fonts; low patience; reading level about 6th grade
Pew Research 2024, Teens and Video Games Today (n=1,453): 85% play, 41% daily; 70% play on a smartphone; 72% play to spend time with others
Thompson, Blair & Henrey 2014, Over the Hill at 24, PLOS ONE (n=3,305, aged 16–44): in-game looking-doing latency starts to rise at about age 24
НАФИ/ВШЭ 2025 (n=4,600, 14+): в видеоигры играют 93% в 14–17 и 90% в 18–24
Яндекс 2022: аудитория до 24 лет ищет игры на двоих, симуляторы и .io
Apple HIG: default control size 44×44 pt; 48 logical px is at least 45 pt even in the smallest WebView viewport
Material 3 bodyLarge 16 sp → 18 logical px
speedMultiplier 1.2 and roundSeconds [30,90] only follow the direction of Thompson 2014; the exact values are not sourced

adults.label: Взрослые
adults.paletteHint: clean modern palette, text contrast at least 4.5:1 (WCAG AA)
avoid: long tutorials
rounds that cannot be finished in a short break
two-handed controls
notes: Playable one-handed during a short break; 40% of mobile play in the T2 data happens during the working day
Best-score persistence and a reason to replay (Yandex Games 2.9)
Puzzle and match-3 audiences skew toward women aged 35+; keep visuals neutral and friendly rather than 'gamer'

sources.title: Android accessibility: touch targets at least 48×48 dp → 52 logical px
Material 3 type scale: bodyLarge 16 sp → 18 logical px (iOS default body 17 pt → 19)
T2, Q1 2025 (35 games, 5.9M monthly players): 35–44 = 41%, 45–54 = 21%; women 56.5%; match-3 is the #2 genre (58% women); 40% of play during the working day
НАФИ/ВШЭ 2025: 54% мобильных игроков предпочитают головоломки; женщины 41% vs мужчины 18%
Newzoo 2019, Betting on Billions (n=6,150): most puzzle players (e.g. Candy Crush) are 36–50 and two-thirds are women
Facebook Gaming/GameRefinery 2020 (>13k players): matching puzzle about 75% women; puzzle 60% over 35; over 7 in 10 prefer shorter sessions
Mediascope: казуальные игры — 35% игровой активности в мобайле
Т-Банк «Ряд наград» (три-в-ряд): 3 млн участников, 36 млн партий (≈12 партий на игрока)
Adjust 2020: hyper-casual 2m39s per user per day vs 19m52s for other games
Билайн: в каталоге игр фильтры «Аркада», «Ферма», «Три-в-ряд»; есть викторины и пасьянс
roundSeconds [45,120] has no direct source (no verified per-round data was found); it fits several rounds into a session of a few minutes

general.label: Все
general.paletteHint: friendly, readable, medium saturation; text contrast at least 4.5:1; never rely on color alone
avoid: complex or multi-finger controls
controls that need scrolling or swiping to reach on the main screen (Yandex Games 1.10.4)
long press opening a selection or context menu (Yandex Games 1.6.1.8)
flashing more than 3 times per second (WCAG 2.3.1)
notes: Understandable within 5 seconds without reading; controls are explained in-game (Yandex Games 2.2)
One-handed play (Yandex Games 1.10.4)
Sound stops when the game loses focus (Yandex Games 1.3); mute and pause buttons are recommended (6.2, 6.3)
Audience is mixed: 20% of the Yandex Games audience is 55+, so sizes sit between the adults and seniors profiles

sources.title: Яндекс Игры, требования: 1.8 удобный размер интерактивных элементов (без числовой нормы); 1.10.4 управление одной рукой без прокрутки; 1.6.1.8; 1.3; 2.2; рекомендации 6.2, 6.3, 6.8
Яндекс Игры, аудитория: 0–24 = 11%, 25–34 = 13%, 35–44 = 49%, 45–54 = 7%, 55+ = 20%; 50% на телефонах (страница без даты)
Material Design: 48 dp ≈ 9 mm, recommended range 7–10 mm, 8 dp spacing → 9 mm = 60 logical px
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.5 (AAA) target size at least 44×44 CSS px; SC 2.5.8 (AA) at least 24×24
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.1: no more than 3 flashes in any 1 s period
Apple HIG: iOS default body text 17 pt → 19 logical px; don't rely on color alone
НАФИ/ВШЭ 2025: головоломки предпочитают 54% мобильных игроков — самый широкий жанр
speedMultiplier 0.9 and roundSeconds [30,120] are a compromise for a mixed audience and are not sourced
